questions.question: Which annotation, already included in @SpringBootApplication, switches on auto-configuration?
options: @ComponentScan
@Configuration
@EnableAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfigureOrder

questions.question: Spring Boot's JsonMapper bean is guarded by @ConditionalOnMissingBean. You define your own JsonMapper bean. What happens?
options: Spring Boot skips its own mapper and uses yours
The app fails because two JsonMapper beans exist
Spring Boot's mapper replaces yours at startup
Both mappers are used, one per request
questions.explanation: @ConditionalOnMissingBean makes auto-configuration back off when a bean of that type already exists.

questions.question: A controller returns a List with one record Dish(String dishName, int priceInRupees), holding Veg Biryani and 180, and application.properties has spring.jackson.property-naming-strategy=SNAKE_CASE. What JSON is returned?
options: [{"dishName":"Veg Biryani","priceInRupees":180}]
[{"dish_name":"Veg Biryani","price_in_rupees":180}]
[{"DishName":"Veg Biryani","PriceInRupees":180}]
[{"dish-name":"Veg Biryani","price-in-rupees":180}]
questions.explanation: The property changes the auto-configured mapper so field names are written in snake_case.

questions.question: In a Spring Boot 4 project a student writes import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; to customise JSON, and the code does not compile. Why?
options: ObjectMapper must be imported from java.util
Jackson is not included with the web starter
The class needs @Configuration first
That is Jackson 2; Spring Boot 4 brings Jackson 3, whose classes are in tools.jackson packages
questions.explanation: Spring Boot 4 uses Jackson 3, so use tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper instead of the Jackson 2 ObjectMapper.

questions.question: You want to know why Spring Boot did not create a DataSource. What is the quickest way to find out?
options: Read the source code of every starter
Delete the target folder and rebuild
Start the app with --debug and read the conditions evaluation report
Add @EnableAutoConfiguration a second time
questions.explanation: The report lists every auto-configuration as a positive match, negative match or exclusion, with the reason.
